item: Launcher: a requested stop that ends in a crash status writes an exit row
summary: Before: after a requested stop (Ctrl-C, close, service stop) only the stop row was written, so an abort (134) or segfault (139) in the teardown was read by the next boot as 'a stop was asked ... Not a crash'. After: a status outside 0, 129, 130, 143 after a requested stop also writes the exit row; a clean stop still writes none. Red-without test.
